mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, the market prices in imminent aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to compressed equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in PAYEMS (above 100k monthly) and decline in UNRATE (below 4.0%) signals a robust labor market, driving corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when PAYEMS > 100 and UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000), the market anticipates economic peak and tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply-side capacity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, aggressive monetary tightening is priced in, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as risk assets face higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100) signals labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate hiring supports earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
